description: This file contains utility functions for handling repository paths, module specifiers, inventory diffing, and inventory collection and validation, primarily used for managing and comparing code inventories in a project.

methods.name: normalizeRepoPath
methods.description: Converts an absolute file path into a relative repository path with forward slashes.

methods.name: resolveRepoSpecifier
methods.description: Resolves a module specifier relative to the repository root, handling relative and absolute specifiers.

methods.name: visitModuleSpecifiers
methods.description: Traverses a TypeScript source file to find import, export, and dynamic import specifiers, invoking a callback for each.

methods.name: diffInventoryEntries
methods.description: Compares expected and actual inventory entries, returning missing and unexpected entries.

methods.name: writeLine
methods.description: Writes a line of text to a stream.

methods.name: collectTypeScriptInventory
methods.description: Reads multiple TypeScript files, creates source files, and collects inventory entries.

methods.name: runBaselineInventoryCheck
methods.description: Performs a baseline check comparing actual and expected inventories, outputting results in JSON or human-readable format.
